jobs.description:
Project Manager - Job Description

The US spends $160 Billion per year on highways. Every new car model costs at least $1 Billion to develop. Yet cars spend only 5% of their time driving. Where do these cars spend the other 95%? PARKED!

LAZ Parking is one of the largest operators in the growing multi-billion-dollar US parking industry. Founded in 1981, LAZ operates hundreds of thousands of parking spaces from offices nationwide. When it comes to parking, we are the experts!

Most importantly, LAZ is a PEOPLE FIRST company with a mission to "create opportunities for our employees and value for our clients." If you're looking to join a growing company led by passionate people committed to being the best, contact us today!

The Spirit of the Position

The Project Management Office (PMO) supports projects across every department at LAZ, including Operations, Finance, Technology, HR, Client Services, and newly acquired or partner businesses. The Project Manager leads cross-functional teams, coordinates internal and external partners, and keeps projects moving toward organizational goals.

The PMO works as both a project lead and a consulting partner. Depending on the project, this role may run a project end to end or help a department plan and run their own work using PMO tools and resources. The right person for this role will be able to adapt to the needs of the business or project in an agile way, always identifying and executing to add value and support.

Principal Duties

Planning and delivery

Build short- and long-term project plans with clear milestones, owners, and deadlines
Track progress against the plan and keep timelines and quality on track
Adjust schedules, scope, and targets as business needs, priorities, or funding change
Coordinate go-live readiness, including user acceptance testing (UAT), data validation, training, pilot rollouts, and handoff to operational owners
Close out projects by confirming ownership transfer, documenting lessons learned, and capturing project outcomes

Team and partner leadership

Lead cross-departmental teams, making roles, responsibilities, and goals clear for everyone involved
Assign and track action items with owners across departments, vendors, and partners
Serve as the main point of contact when multiple teams or departments share a project so everyone stays aligned
Manage vendor and partner relationships through implementation, including kickoffs, recurring status calls, contract and timeline coordination, and follow-up on open items
Support the integration of acquired or partner businesses onto LAZ systems and processes
Lay out options and tradeoffs so sponsors and stakeholders can make timely decisions

Communication and reporting

Facilitate recurring project meetings and send timely recaps with decisions, action items, owners, and due dates
Keep stakeholders updated so the project stays aligned with their goals
Build and maintain Monday.com boards and dashboards, project reports, and all project communications
Contribute to portfolio-level reporting, including the monthly PMO Executive Summary

PMO intake and continuous improvement

Support the PMO intake and discovery process by helping requesters through intake, connecting them with the right teams, and helping build business cases
Contribute to PMO resources such as playbooks, SOPs, templates, SharePoint content, newsletters, and feedback surveys
Help departments plan and run their own projects using PMO tools and best practices

Education

Bachelor's degree in business, management, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience
PMP or CAPM certification preferred

Experience

5+ years of project management experience, ideally in a PMO or multi-department setting
Experience leading software or system implementations with outside vendors
Experience with business integrations, operational transitions, or process changes across multiple departments is a plus

Skills

Works independently and makes timely calls on day-to-day project matters
Leads cross-functional teams without direct authority, including resolving conflicts and negotiating effectively
Manages vendor and partner relationships, keeping outside teams accountable to timelines and deliverables
Prioritizes tasks, manages time, and handles multiple projects across different departments at once
Works comfortably with people at every level of the organization, from frontline teams to executives
Strong written communication, including clear meeting recaps, status updates, and executive summaries
Brings a sense of urgency and follow-through
Adapts quickly to changing project requirements and priorities
Supports change management and business readiness so new tools and processes actually get adopted
Familiar with project management and collaboration tools such as Monday.com, Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Loop), Jira, Trello, Asana, or GitHub
Comfortable working through system integrations and implementations with IT, development teams, and vendors, and willing to learn technical concepts as needed
Translates between technical and non-technical stakeholders so everyone has a shared understanding of project requirements

Exempt

Overview

We are looking for an experienced, highly organized and proactive Web Development Project Manager
to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced digital environment, enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows and knows how to keep multiple projects, people and deadlines moving at the same time. You will be responsible for coordinating projects across different teams, monitoring progress, identifying potential delays and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who does more than simply update tasks. You should be comfortable taking ownership of projects from start to finish

We are looking for candidates with web development project management experience
— this is a priority for the role. Experience in a digital marketing agency

Manage multiple projects simultaneously from planning through to completion.

jobs.description:
Position Title

Pre-Award Project Manager - Grants Hub

Job Group

Professional & Scientific

Required Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree and 3 years of related experience

Job Description

Summary of Duties and Responsibilities:

Enjoy bringing people, ideas, and resources together to turn ambitious research concepts into competitive funding proposals? Looking for a role where you can collaborate with researchers and stakeholders across a wide range of disciplines?

If so, the Grants Hub is seeking a Pre-Award Project Manager to support the successful development of interdisciplinary research (IDR) teams and proposals at Iowa State University! This position will coordinate the preparation and submission of large, complex grant proposals involving multiple stakeholders and provide project management support to IDR teams, starting from team formation and continuing through handoff to a post-award project manager. This position will be classified as a Research Administrator II.

The Pre-Award Project Manager will work with researchers from all colleges and disciplines, with an emphasis on large, center-type proposals that involve researchers and stakeholders from multiple colleges, institutions, and sectors. This role will also serve as the primary point of contact to coordinate the Grants Hub’s comprehensive team-based proposal development support for selected IDR teams.

What You'll Do

Develop proposal checklists and calendars, identify key milestones and deadlines, assign tasks, and track progress towards deliverables.
Work with IDR teams to identify and manage project scope, goals, risks, resources, and stakeholders.
Develop project communications and reporting plans.
Manage proposal-related communications with IDR teams, collaborators, stakeholders, and other sponsored funding support staff and actively participate in and facilitate working group meetings.
Manage preparations and logistics for site visits and reverse site visits.
Provide back-up and supplemental pre-award administration support, including budget development, document collection and review, and proposal routing and submission.
Collaborate with other Grants Hub staff and external consultants to coordinate proposal-strengthening activities such as strategic intelligence analyses and color team reviews.
Identify and implement improvements to project management and pre-award research administration processes, including through development of AI agents and automated workflows.

The successful candidate will have exceptional organizational and time management skills; strong oral and written communications skills; a proactive and collaborative approach to customer service and relationship building; a high attention to detail; and the ability to adjust to shifting deadlines and priorities.

The successful candidate must reside in the state of Iowa on or before their start date. This position offers the flexibility to work on-site in Ames or in a hybrid work arrangement as well.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in managing the development and submission of complex research grant proposals and budgets involving multiple investigators and subcontracts.
Experience with Federal regulations and agency policies and guidelines for sponsored research, proposal submission, and budgeting.
Demonstrated experience working with interdisciplinary research teams, preferably in a university environment.
Experience developing and managing strategic partnerships and collaborating with multiple stakeholders.
Experience and/or formal training or certification in project management methodologies, frameworks, and best practices applied to complex research projects, grant development, or strategic initiatives involving interdisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders.
Experience leveraging technology, AI tools, and/or automated workflows to improve project management, grant development, research administration, or other complex administrative processes.

About Grants Hub At Iowa State University

The Grants Hub is Iowa State’s central research development unit, located within the Office of the Vice President for Research. We are proactive and future-focused, providing strategic pre-award support and consultation to help researchers successfully compete for funding and build high-impact research teams. Our broad range of services are available to new and experienced investigators from all colleges, departments, and disciplines. To learn more, please visit Grants Hub.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Program Manager | Data Center Network Deployments | Remote

Our client is building and expanding data center network capacity at fleet scale. As the accountable program lead, you would take approved network designs and turn them into predictable delivery across many sites, from new builds and capacity expansions to retrofits, refreshes and decommissions.

This is a program leadership role first. You will not configure network equipment, and you will not own the design. You will own the plan, the sequence and the commitment, and you will be the person who stops a deployment from starting when the design, materials or site are not ready.

What you will do

Own a half-over-half execution roadmap across new builds, front-end fabric projects, technology modifications, retrofits and special initiatives
Run intake and readiness gates, and refuse to start work until the design package, bill of materials, method of procedure, site requirements and dependency map are complete
Own delivery from kickoff through material arrival, installation, provisioning, validation, operational handoff and closeout
Hold portfolio-level visibility of hardware demand, supply and need-by dates, and make allocation trade-offs between competing projects and regions
Keep a risk and dependency register with quantified schedule impact, and run change control for design, BOM, scope and schedule changes
Align engineering, supply chain, construction, logistics, site teams and vendors, without direct authority over any of them
Present portfolio health, material risk and decisions needed to senior leadership
Build automated reporting and dashboards from imperfect operational data, and turn lessons learned into reusable playbooks

What we are looking for

10+ years of technical program or portfolio management in network infrastructure, data centers, cloud infrastructure or telecommunications
Ownership of complex, multi-site deployment programs from intake through operational handoff
Working knowledge of data center network fabrics, including spine and leaf, top of rack, physical topology and redundancy, enough to question a design package and hold your own with engineers
Hands-on experience with BOMs, hardware demand planning, material allocation and supply-risk management
Proven ability to prioritise concurrent programs that share hardware, engineering and field resources
A track record of building metrics, dashboards and automation that remove manual reporting
Executive communication, with concise written updates and confident readouts

Who this is not for

If your background is software, application or server program management, this role will not suit you.
The same applies to construction project management with no network content, or to program management that stops at coordination and never touches hardware supply or readiness gating.
Telecom, carrier and data center network deployment backgrounds are very welcome.

Preferred

Data center network fabric delivery at hyperscale or across a large fleet
Front-end fabric deployments, lifecycle retrofits, hardware migrations or decommissions
Experience partnering with construction, facilities, supply chain, logistics and field engineering
AI-assisted workflow optimisation or program analytics
PMP, PgMP, or network, cloud or data center certification
Bachelor’s degree in a technical or business field, or equivalent experience. An MBA is a plus.

If interested, please apply with your most up-to-date resume & I'll be in touch.

World Vision is looking for a Program Manager to support in the planning, coordination and management of World Vision's response to rapid onset and complex humanitarian emergencies. They will provide management and oversight of public (USG) and private funded projects, ensuring high-quality implementation and compliance with donor requirements. The individual will utilize humanitarian expertise and deep understanding of World Vision’s programs to effectively articulate World Vision’s strategy and approach to partners, donors, and other key stakeholders.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Keep Christ central in individual and corporate life. Actively participate in and contribute to the spiritual disciplines of the organization (Christian conduct, chapel, prayer, worship, devotions, and leadership of devotions); incorporate WV Core Values into decisions within scope of role.
Ensure that projects are managed effectively through appropriate, timely and detailed communication with appropriate internal teams and relevant stakeholders regarding major issues and successes related to the project. Coordinate with appropriate staff and leadership to encourage and facilitate the documentation of promising practices and lessons learned.
Work alongside the HEA Operations Team in managing and coordinating disaster responses and ensuring high-quality HEA programming. Specific tasks may include:
Remain in ongoing communication with key Regional and National Office counterparts on early warning issues.
Ensure adequate coordination between all WVUS stakeholders and the field in the context of a disaster response.
Serve as a primary contact point on disasters for all WV stakeholders, including Donor Engagement, Media, Advocacy, and the International Program Group.
Evaluate field needs and recommend commitments from the Reserve Funds accordingly.
Brief WVUS stakeholders regarding the ongoing status of unfolding emergencies and WV responses in the field.
Participate in relevant InterAction and other working group meetings, as delegated/determined by the relevant Team Leader.
Provide support to the field, including technical review and finalization of response strategies, plans and budgets.
Identify implementation risks, operational bottlenecks, and compliance controls, and work with field and support office teams to develop mitigation measures.
Promote accountability to affected populations, safeguarding, protection mainstreaming, and adherence to humanitarian quality standards throughout project implementation.
Build and maintain relationships with key WV partners to enhance their understanding of WV's strategy for engagement with the USG and other key donors.
Contribute, as necessary, to the development of new public, private, and bilateral grant proposals.

Interact with Regional Offices, National Offices and in-country response teams to provide technical and general support to an assigned regional and/or sector-focused portfolio of rapid onset and chronic emergency responses. Support includes but is not limited to:
Support needs assessments, program design, start-up, phase-in, phase-out, customer service, communications, reporting, monitoring and/or evaluation activities
Facilitate coordination between programming, finance, operations, grants, and technical teams to strengthen project implementation
Support the integration of learning, evidence generation, and adaptive management into project implementation
Develop reporting and evaluation processes for performance management of programs
Ensure applicable WVUS program standards meet or exceed donor expectations
Lead or participate in emergency response program development
Lead, participate in, or facilitate assessments, surveys or evaluations as necessary for risk management, standards setting, policy formation and program development
Serve as a member of the WVI HEA Global Surge Capacity Network (GSCN) and as such be deployable to high-visibility Category III, Level 3 emergencies if needed.
Collaborate with WVUS IPG teams and WVI regional and national offices to develop and conduct training in emergency response program methodologies and concepts, including program design, best practices and technical trends, monitoring and evaluation.
Encourage and facilitate the documentation of best practices and lessons learned in the context of an assigned portfolio, directed toward multiple audiences, to influence policy formation, develop capacity and foster professionalism.
Public Program Responsibilities:
Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of trends, issues and discussions related to the IPG/HEA team’s primary public, private, and bilateral donors, including: US Department of State, UN OCHA, UNHCR, and UNICEF relief grants.
Ensure compliance with donor regulations, award conditions, and WV policies throughout the project cycles.
Support donor engagement activities, including donor meetings, field visits, presentations, and information requests.
Support public grant acquisition within assigned rapid-onset and chronic emergency response portfolio, including project and proposal development, standard setting, tools development for capacity building, setting and monitoring milestones, policy and contracts review
Management and financial oversight of grant funded projects and overall grant portfolio, including standard setting, tools development, capacity building, and monitoring and evaluation
Maintain awareness of corporate goals, objectives, organizational announcements, and activities. Reference and follow organizational policies and procedures, seeking clarity as need

YOU BRING THESE SKILLS

Organizational Awareness: Understands business operations and the mission, work and priorities of the organization. Applies understanding of organization's informal structure, culture and climate in achieving goals.

Program Design and Implementation: Effectively design development and relief programs that transform communities in need. Understands how to acquire and integrate resources to support program design. Carries out the vision of ministry program.

Program Monitoring & Reporting: Effectively monitors and reports on the financial results of program implementation. Understands how to convert WVUS reports into donor reports. Generates reports that are straightforward, comprehensible and timely.

Sector Knowledge: Understand current methodologies and standards associated with different sectors and effectively applies knowledge in designing, monitoring and evaluating programs.

Managing Resources: Identifies appropriate people, facilities, tools and materials, time constraints, vendors, etc. for accomplishing goals. Considers potential costs and benefits of resources prior to allocating them.

English Language Proficiency: The ability to speak, understand and write fluently in English.

REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience (eight years). Master's degree in related field such as international relations, social sciences, etc. preferred. In addition to education or education equivalent, requires a minimum of five years related work experience. Understanding of the key issues in humanitarian and emergency affairs and in-depth knowledge of areas of responsibility required. Ability to apply skills and paradigms appropriately in a relief or chronic humanitarian emergency context. Proven work experience in grant writing and other relevant skills. Demonstrated ability to facilitate collaboration in complex settings required. Computer skills required. Proven experience effectively managing large projects and successful resolution of implementation challenges and demonstrated ability to facilitate multi-stakeholder engagement preferred. Computer skills required.

SALARY & BENEFITS

WVUS Pay Grade Level: 225
Estimated hiring range: $81,300 to $112,590

ABOUT WORLD VISION

We're a global Christian humanitarian organization. We partner with children, families, and their communities to empower them as they reach their full potential by tackling the causes of poverty and injustice. For 75 years, World Vision has followed Jesus' example to show unconditional love to the poor and oppressed. We serve every child regardless of faith.

L.I.F.E. LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES:

The LIFE Leadership Competencies provide a shared framework for Christ-centered leadership at World Vision. They define the skills, behaviors, and character qualities that help leaders lead faithfully and effectively, shaping how we hire, develop, and evaluate leaders to cultivate thriving teams and greater Kingdom impact.

Love: How we show up every day, every interaction.

Ignite
: How we unlock and catalyze.
To Ignite is to unlock purpose, passion, and potential—so people can bring their best in service of children and donors. We build healthy, thriving teams and develop character, competence, and courage.

To Fulfill is to focus on what matters most—and deliver with excellence and accountability. We own outcomes. We prioritize mission-critical work. And we partner with God to produce results that advance Kingdom impact.
Envision
: How we change and evolve towards ‘Better’.
To Envision is to lead boldly into the future—discerning what’s ahead with faith, navigating complexity, and casting vision that leads to lasting impact.

Description

Do you love working with diverse set of customers and engineers? Are you excited about bringing clarity and delivering through ambiguity? Do you want to deliver initiatives that make it easy for builders, security and compliance teams to drive better security outcomes? Are you keen on solving problems that no other company has solved?

Here in Amazon Defensive Security, we have that special role just for you! The Vulnerability Management and Remediation Engineering team is building the next generation of mission critical security systems for protecting Amazon assets. Our innovations enable fast, efficient, and effective security across the globe to keep customer's data safe. Our customers are Amazon, internal stakeholders, and Amazon’s customers. Our technical program managers work directly with stakeholders, get close to customers' needs, and are empowered to take technical risks to help build the best-in-class software with respect to quality, usability, and scale.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Program Manager who will support VMR Engineering teams to design and deliver security outcomes that positively impact our security posture at scale for Amazon customers and builders. You will partner with security and engineering leaders across Amazon businesses to work backwards from customer security, design initiatives to achieve those outcomes, and drive delivery against those commitments. You will operate amidst ambiguity, where the problem and strategy may not be defined. You will deliver clarity by leading and collaborating with partner teams to define the strategic vision, and influence program and product roadmaps and strategies that will realize that vision.

The right candidate for this role is an experienced program manager with deep technical knowledge, business acumen, a security-first mindset, highly effective written and verbal communication. Characteristics that will make this candidate effective include demonstrated abilities to: [1] dive deep into complex problem spaces while maintaining focus on the larger strategic objectives, [2] build trust and negotiate mutually beneficial outcomes with partners through transparency and delivery on commitments, and [3] communicate with clarity and candor to distill complex topics into simple terms while practicing respect for diverse ideas.

Key job responsibilities

You will partner with security and engineering leaders across Amazon business and security teams to work backwards from customer security outcomes, design initiatives to achieve those outcomes, and drive delivery against those commitments.
You will operate amidst ambiguity, where the problem and strategy may not be defined. You will deliver clarity by leading through your team and collaborating with partner teams to define the strategic vision, and influence program and product roadmaps and strategies that will realize that vision.
You will bring strong business and technical acumen to apply data-driven judgements and influence product, program, and architecture decisions.
You will support VMR Engineering teams in driving business and program reviews, aligning with stakeholders, and establishing mechanisms to continuously improve execution.
You will be representing verbally and in writing complex decisions, trade-offs, and potential solutions clearly to senior security and business leaders.

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering
Experience in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk management, and critical path management

5+ years of software development experience

jobs.title: Program Manager | Office of University Life and Community Engagement
jobs.description:
Organization Overview

To embrace and honor a diversity of lived experiences, it is critical that we all listen with an open mind. We do this to translate those conversations into collective actions that lead to outcomes grounded in our longstanding mission to benefit humanity. Our understanding of humanity is inclusive of all human beings and oriented toward compassion and generosity.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Vice President for University Life and Community Engagement, the Program Manager plays a central role in building a connected, engaged, and supportive Rockefeller University community. The Program Manager develops, implements, and evaluates programs and initiatives that bring members of the University together, strengthen relationships and connections across the community, support professional and leadership development, and enhance the experience of graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, faculty, and staff. Engagement is a central focus of the position. The Program Manager develops opportunities for members of the Rockefeller community to connect with one another, participate meaningfully in the life of the University, build relationships across roles and disciplines, and contribute to a strong academic and scientific environment. The position works across the University to understand community needs, identify opportunities for connection and engagement, and translate those needs into thoughtful programs, events, learning experiences, and other initiatives. The Program Manager assesses community needs, develops programs, manages resources, evaluates outcomes, and recommends improvements based on assessment findings. The position serves as a key contributor to initiatives that strengthen community connection, professional growth, participation, and the overall University experience.

Position Responsibilities

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To, The Following

Develop, implement, manage, and assess programs and initiatives that build community, strengthen engagement and connection, and support professional and leadership development. Create opportunities for graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, faculty, staff, and other members of the University community to connect across roles, disciplines, backgrounds, and areas of the institution.
Develop and facilitate programs, events, workshops, learning experiences, and other initiatives that foster meaningful participation in University life and strengthen relationships within the Rockefeller community.
Develop and facilitate a scientific professional development curriculum or learning module that addresses topics relevant to the academic research environment, including mentoring, leadership, communication, collaboration, career development, research culture, and professional effectiveness. Apply knowledge of the scientific research environment to the design of community and professional development programs, ensuring they are relevant to the experiences and needs of scientists and scientific trainees.
Support graduate student and postdoctoral communities through programming, outreach, relationship-building, professional development, resource development, and individualized support.
Develop educational resources, facilitator guides, workshop materials, and other tools that support community engagement and the professional and leadership development of members of the University community.
Assess community needs through data collection, feedback, consultation, and program evaluation, and use findings to inform program development and decision-making. Manage multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously, ensuring timely execution and achievement of established goals and objectives.
Collaborate with campus stakeholders to identify opportunities for new programs, services, community-building efforts, professional development offerings, and engagement initiatives. Collect, analyze, and report participation, assessment, and outcome data to evaluate program effectiveness and guide continuous improvement.
Manage program budgets and resources, including monitoring expenditures and ensuring responsible stewardship of University funds. Coordinate and oversee vendors, consultants, facilitators, and external partners as needed to support program implementation.
Develop communications, newsletters, reports, presentations, educational materials, and other resources that support community engagement, professional development, and Office priorities.
Represent the Office of University Life and Community Engagement on committees, working groups, and collaborative initiatives as assigned.
Demonstrate knowledge of The Rockefeller University's mission, values, scientific environment, and strategic priorities, and incorporate them into the performance of duties.
Other duties and special projects as assigned.

Position Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's degree and at least five (5) years of related experience.
Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, and evaluating community engagement, educational, professional development, or related programs or initiatives.
Working knowledge of the academic scientific research environment, including familiarity with the experiences and professional development needs of scientists, graduate students, or other members of the research community. Demonstrated experience creating and facilitating workshops, educational programs, professional development experiences, or community-building initiatives.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Experience managing budgets, resources, and complex projects.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with scientific and non-scientific audiences. Demonstrated ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively with faculty, scientists, staff, trainees, and other stakeholders.
Strong interpersonal, diplomacy, and relationship-building skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to use assessment and evaluation data to inform decisions.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn and use program-management and data-tracking platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in a scientific discipline, education, higher education, student affairs, organizational development, or a related field. Experience working in a biomedical research university, academic research environment, graduate education, postdoctoral affairs, faculty development, community engagement, or a related setting.
Experience designing and facilitating professional development programs for scientists, graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, faculty, or other members of an academic research community.
Experience developing scientific, research, or professional skills curricula or educational modules.
Experience training or supporting graduate students, postdoctoral researchers, faculty, research mentors, or other members of the scientific community.
Experience developing educational resources, curricula, facilitator guides, mentorship tools, or other learning materials.
Experience assessing program outcomes and using data and participant feedback to drive continuous improvement. Demonstrated success in building partnerships across organizational units and stakeholder groups.
Familiarity with the culture, structures, and professional pathways of academic biomedical research.
Experience using Airtable or similar project-management, database, or participant-tracking platforms.

About Code Metal

Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others.

jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The primary function of the Information Assurance Manager (Security Manager Information Assurance)
is to ensure security policies standards and procedures are implemented in a way that aligns with the Aerospace and Government customer requirements. This position is responsible for supporting Department of Defense (DoD) Collateral information systems. This position supports both Aerospace and Government customers within a classified environment and is responsible for managing assets and Information Assurance staff.

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in El Segundo, CA.

What You’ll Be Doing

Functions as the primary Information System Security Manager (ISSM)
Supervise a team of Information System Security Officers (ISSOs) supporting Collateral programs.
Ensure proper IA staffing levels are met and maintained to meet the needs of our internal and external customers.
Coordinates technical assessments of managed assets
Provides counsel to government organizations relative to information assurance practices issues and concerns ensuring continued mission success.
Obtains government Authorization to Operate (ATOs) – through the appropriate government channels – by creating and maintaining System Security Plans (SSPs) and other related documentation per system for multiple government customers.
Conducts weekly audit log reviews for inappropriate activity.
Conducts evaluation and analysis of software/hardware intended for use on the classified systems.
Obtains approval (through the appropriate government channels) for hardware and software utilized on classified systems.
Prepares for and assists with government inspections. Documents and executes test procedures.
Ensures Government security policies procedures and standards are understood and followed by personnel.
Monitors low to high and high to low data transfers performed by data transfer agents (DTA) to ensure compliance with government regulations.
Possesses the knowledge of techniques to sanitize system components memory and media – and to verify IT personnel has properly implemented.
Understands complex Government regulations and translates them into necessary technical and security solutions.
Trains and briefs staff on information assurance for classified systems. Verifies (through appropriate channels) users have appropriate security clearances and need to know. Provides initial IA briefing and annual refresher.
Reports security incidents (including classified messaging incidents) and assists with the resulting investigation as required. Ensures proper protection or corrective measures have been taken.
Communicates regularly with Government (and Aerospace) customers for status of requests and facilitating the completion of requests.

What You Need to be Successful - Security Manager Information Assurance

Minimum Requirements

High school diploma with 10 or more years of experience or Bachelor's degree with 5 or more years of experience
Ability to simultaneously manage multiple assets through the assessment and authorization (A&A) process to obtain the Authorization to Operate (ATO)
DoD 8570/8140 IAM level II or II certification (CISSP, GSLC, CISM) or have within 6 months of hire.
This position requires a current Top Secret clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.

How You Can Stand Out

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

8 or more years of relevant information security management experience
Previous leadership experience in Information Assurance/Cybersecurity
TS/SCI clearance eligibility
Experience with the assessment and authorization (A&A) process and obtaining Authorization to Operate (ATO) for multiple systems
Experience with the control families in NIST 800-53 and the tests necessary to show the controls have been properly implemented. Understanding of Confidentiality Integrity and Availability and how CNNSI 1253 determines these for federal information systems
Experience with ICD-503 and other Intelligence Community Directives/Standards
Experience in utilizing compliance and vulnerability tools; such as Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS) and Nessus
Experience with IA tools such as eMass, ArcSight, SNoW, TALON,
Understand Intelligence Community Vulnerability Alerts (ICVA) and Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE)

Job Description

Everforth ECS is seeking an Information Systems Security Manager to work in Groton, Connecticut office.

Everforth ECS is seeking an experienced Information System Security Manager (ISSM) to support U.S. Navy systems and programs. The ISSM will serve as the primary cybersecurity authority for assigned systems, ensuring compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) and Department of the Navy (DON) cybersecurity policies under the Risk Management Framework (RMF).

The ideal candidate will have deep experience supporting Navy Authorizing Officials (AOs), working within Navy/DoD environments such as NAVWAR, NAVAIR, NAVSEA, or Fleet Cyber Command, and maintaining system authorization packages in eMASS.

The ISSM will lead the preparations and interactions with the government for system security assessments and ensure the IS maintains its Authority to Operate (ATO). The ISSM will manage the implementation of security policies, conduct risk assessments, manage security controls, and Plan of Actions and Milestones (POAM).

The ISSM is expected to advise senior management on cybersecurity issues, communicate security risks, and collaborate with technical teams and other stakeholders. The successful candidate is able to multitask; assume ownership and accountability of risks, issues, and tasks; and successfully manage and resolve those risks, issues, and tasks to completion. The successful candidate is also able to work well in a team-oriented environment; self-manage his/her own tasks; and provide hands-on guidance, direction, and mentoring to the technical team. Finally, the successful candidate is extremely well-organized, well written, has a keen eye for detail, and can clearly articulate information (both orally and in writing) to customers, stakeholders, peers, and leadership within and external to the Program and organization.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the ISSM for Navy information systems in accordance with DoDI 8510.01 (RMF) and DoDI 8500.01 (Cybersecurity)
Oversee the full RMF lifecycle: categorization, control selection, implementation, assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring
Develop, maintain, and manage RMF documentation including:
System Security Plans (SSPs)

Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&Ms)
Continuous Monitoring Strategies

Interface directly with Navy stakeholders including:
Authorizing Officials (AOs)

Program Managers (PMs)

Manage system accreditation activities within eMASS and ensure data accuracy and completeness
Conduct and support security control assessments, vulnerability management, and mitigation tracking
Ensure compliance with STIGs (Security Technical Implementation Guides) and SRGs (Security Requirements Guides) from DISA
Support audits, inspections, and cybersecurity readiness reviews (e.g., FISMA, DON CIO inspections)
Provide cybersecurity guidance to engineering teams throughout system development lifecycle (SDLC), aligning with DevSecOps practices where applicable
Oversee incident response coordination in alignment with DoDI 8530.01 (Cyber Incident Response) and Navy procedures

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
8+ years of cybersecurity experience, with 3+ years as an ISSM or senior ISSO in a DoD/Navy environment
Required experience with AWS GovCloud
Strong experience implementing RMF under DoDI 8510.01 (latest version)
Hands-on experience with eMASS
In-depth knowledge of:
NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls

DoDI 8500.01 / 8510.01

SECNAV M-5239.1
Experience supporting Navy programs (e.g., NAVWAR, NAVAIR, NAVSEA, or USMC systems)

HBSS / Endpoint Security Solutions

Experience with DevSecOps pipelines and containerized environments

Experience organizing, scheduling, and leading meetings with internal teams and customers
Experience coordinating with general contractors and end clients
Microsoft Office (Word and Excel)
Microsoft Project
Addtional Qualifications considered a plus:
Electrical low voltage installation and subcontractor management experience
Basic understanding of HVAC systems in large building automation systems
Basic understanding of sequence of operations and P&IDs for HVAC and plant utilities
Basic understanding of instrumentation and control valves for HVAC systems
Building automation and/or industrial controls experience (Rockwell, Schneider, AVEVA, Inductive Automation) is a plus
Onsite commissioning experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Information Technology Project Manager (INSCOM)
jobs.description:
Description

SENIOR INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY PROJECT MANAGER

At B&A, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. B&A believes in ensuring its employees feel deeply connected to B&A, recognizing successes and hard work, and providing continuous opportunities to learn and grow. Our people are entrepreneurial thinkers that combine mindset, vision, and experience to drive value – not only to us as an organization, but to the clients we support. We promote a collaborative culture with our clients, and with each other, as one team working towards a common vision. We’d love for you to join our team!

Job Summary

B&A is seeking a Senior Information Technology Project Manager
to support the U.S. Army INSCOM Scalable GEOINT Architecture Contractor Manpower Equivalent (CME) Information Technology Support Services contract. The role supports Army GEOINT Office systems, software, security, and mission users. Primary duty location: Fort Gordon, GA.

Anticipated Award: January 2027
Anticipated Start: January 11, 2027
Period of Performance: 1 Base Year + 4 Option Years

Location

Fort Gordon, GA

Responsibilities

Plan, initiate, and manage information technology (IT) projects.
Lead and guide the work of technical staff, serving as a liaison between business and technical aspects of projects.
Plan project stages and assess business implications for each stage.
Monitor project progress to ensure deadlines, standards, and cost targets are met.
Manage project execution to ensure adherence to budget, schedule, and scope.
Collaborate with project personnel to identify and resolve problems.
Monitor and track project milestones and deliverables.
Submit project deliverables while ensuring adherence to quality standards.
Assess current and future customer needs and priorities through direct communication, surveys, or other methods.
Initiate, review, and approve modifications to project plans.
Schedule and facilitate meetings related to IT projects.
Direct and coordinate the activities of project personnel.
Develop implementation plans, including cost-benefit and return-on-investment (ROI) analyses.
Identify requirements for initial or supplemental project resources.
Develop and update project plans outlining objectives, technologies, systems, specifications, funding, and staffing.
Perform risk assessments and develop appropriate response strategies.
Prepare project status reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.
Identify, review, and select vendors or consultants to meet project needs.
Develop and manage annual budgets for IT projects.
Establish and execute project communication plans.
Develop and manage work breakdown structures (WBS) for IT projects.
Monitor project team performance and provide documented performance feedback.
Coordinate recruitment and selection of project personnel.
Assign duties, responsibilities, and authority to project personnel.
Negotiate with project stakeholders or suppliers to obtain necessary resources and materials.

Education And Experience

5–10+ years in IT project management
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
Requires a proven track record of managing large IT projects, overseeing contracts, and tracking progress.
PMP certification is required. PgMP is desired.

Security Clearance

Active TS/SCI clearance, adjudicated within the last five (5) years

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without accommodation.
Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
Frequently operate standard office equipment, including computers and telephones.
Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, video conference, and email.
Occasionally move about the office and lift up to 20 pounds.
Ability to work the assigned schedule with regular and reliable attendance.
Ability to travel up to 10% as required.

More About B&A

B&A delivers secure, innovative, and mission-critical IT solutions to support the United States Government across all three branches—Executive, Legislative, and Judicial—focused on National Security, Defense, and Intelligence. Our team of cleared professionals specializes in Agile DevSecOps, Cloud Migration and Modernization, Data Science and Analytics, Human Capital Management, Operations and Enablement, Application Transformation, All-Source Intelligence, Geospatial Production, Engineering and Integrated Services, and Cybersecurity.

Notable Clients
B&A has grown to be a company that is trusted by our clients for exceptional service, innovative solutions, and inspired employees. Our service extends through federal, state, and local Government, the private sector, and higher education. Some of our notable clients include Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, U.S. Senate, U.S. Courts, U.S. Census Bureau, U.S. Navy, and more.

Benefits and Programs

B&A is proud to offer three robust individual and family medical plans to full time employees, including a Health Savings Account (HSA) option as well as two tiers of dental coverage, vision, life & AD&D, disability, accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness insurance. In addition to these benefits, B&A employees enjoy paid time off, B&A sponsored trainings and certifications, pet insurance benefits, commuter transit benefits and a free subscription to a virtual exercise platform (NEOU). B&A’s 401(k) plan is available to all employees and includes a company matching contribution.

B&A has launched several programs to focus on employee engagement, wellness, and assistance. These include:

The B&A Cares program: 30/60/90-day wellness check ins, personal development, financial management, and stress management seminars, and more
A formal mentorship program
Job shadowing and cross training opportunities
Brand Ambassador program
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access to various support resources to include counseling, legal guidance, financial planning, and more
Monthly teambuilding events
B&A Annual Wellness Challenges: #StepWithB&A, #WalkDuringLunchWithB&A, #VolunteeringWithB&A, #ExerciseDuringLunchWithB&A, and more

At B&A, we place significant importance on improving the communities and lives of citizens across the nation through our involvement, technology expertise, and employees. B&A puts an emphasis on charitable efforts in the Northern Virginia area, including Capital Area Food Bank pantry drives, book donations, Hope for Henry Foundation events, and many more. In recognition of all these efforts, B&A has been named a Companies as Responsive Employers (CARE) award recipient by Northern Virginia Family Services and nominated by the Northern Virginia Chamber of Commerce for Outstanding Corporate Citizenship Award.

EEO

B&A provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. B&A complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy covers conduct occurring at B&A’s offices, and other workplaces (including client sites) and all other locations where B&A is providing services, and to all work-related activities.

EEO is the Law

B&A participates in e-Verify. We provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s I-9 Form to confirm work authorization.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you a Project Manager who knows how to keep things moving, bring people together and navigate challenges without losing sight of the bigger picture?
We're looking for an experienced Project Manager to join Orion Health on a 12-month fixed-term contract!
In this role, you'll manage a portfolio of healthcare technology projects, working closely with customers and internal teams to deliver successful outcomes.
You'll be stepping into an established portfolio of customer relationships and projects, including work with some of New Zealand's leading healthcare organisations. From managing multiple smaller workstreams to overseeing larger implementation projects, you'll need to be comfortable juggling competing priorities while keeping stakeholders informed and engaged.
We're looking for someone who brings a practical, flexible approach to project management. Someone who can confidently manage scope, timelines and deliverables, while recognising that strong relationships and open communication are just as important as the project plan.
What you'll be doing:

Managing multiple healthcare technology projects from planning through to delivery.
Coordinating project activities, resources, timelines and budgets to ensure successful outcomes.
Building and maintaining strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
Managing project scope, risks, issues and changing requirements with a pragmatic approach.
Facilitating clear communication between customers, technical teams and other stakeholders.
Balancing competing priorities across multiple projects and workstreams.
Taking ownership of project delivery while working collaboratively to resolve challenges.

About You

We're looking for an experienced Project Manager who combines strong delivery skills with excellent stakeholder management and a genuine ability to build trust.
Ideally, you'll bring:
4+ years of experience managing software implementation, IT or technology projects.
Experience managing multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trusted customer relationships.
Excellent communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
The confidence to take ownership, make decisions and know when to seek input or escalate.
A flexible, solutions-focused approach and the ability to adapt as priorities change.
Strong organisational skills and the ability to keep projects on track without being overly reliant on rigid processes.

Experience in healthcare IT or health technology would be a bonus, but isn't essential. We're equally interested in hearing from Project Managers who have successfully delivered complex technology projects in other industries.
Formal project management certifications such as PRINCE2 or PMP are welcome, but they're not a requirement.
What matters most is your ability to build relationships, communicate with empathy and deliver results. You'll know when to challenge, when to listen and how to find solutions that work for everyone involved.
A little about us

Orion Health is a global healthcare technology company headquartered in New Zealand, with more than 30 years of experience developing technology that helps healthcare organisations securely connect, manage, and make sense of complex health data. Our solutions support healthcare organisations around the world, helping to improve access to information, streamline care, and deliver better outcomes for patients.
Orion Health is also a part of HEALWELL AI, a publicly listed healthcare AI company focused on preventative care and the early identification and detection of disease. HEALWELL's ecosystem brings together healthcare AI, data, interoperability and software capabilities, with a shared mission to improve healthcare and save lives through technology.
Together, Orion Health and HEALWELL AI are at an exciting stage of growth, combining Orion Health's global healthcare technology and data infrastructure with HEALWELL's AI capabilities to help deliver smarter, more connected healthcare.
Why you'll love working here

Our offices are energetic hubs packed with fun - think foosball, pool table, arcade games and a PlayStation.
Hybrid working lets you design your day around collaboration and flexibility.
We provide free breakfast, fruit, and barista-grade coffee every day - plus an onsite café so you don't need to venture far!

We use a secure platform with AI tools that help organise applications fairly and efficiently. All hiring decisions are made by humans, and your data is handled per applicable privacy laws. For additional privacy information, see our  Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Transportation PDP Rail and Transit)
jobs.description:
Overview

Be trusted to make great things happen.

You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We're proud to say it's thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise and knowledge. And when you join us, you'll be a part of this genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone's voice is valued and treated equally.

AtkinsRéalis Transportation Project Delivery Practice (PDP) is the centre of excellence for the delivery of major transportation infrastructure projects and combines the best in project management and design management to provide a full suite of services to clients in the public and private sectors. The team is responsible for delivery of design services across our markets of Rail and Transit, Highways and Local Transport, and lean out into other sectors including Defence and Nuclear. We have a wide client base including HS2, National Highways, Network Rail, Irish Rail, Local Authorities, as well as several Principal Contractors.

This is an exciting opportunity within the PDP Rail and Transit team for an experienced Senior Project Manager looking to lead the successful delivery of our projects, influence the growth and development of the project management team and progress into a Project Director role.

With a home office in Manchester, Birmingham, Derby or Stockton-on-Tees, this role requires flexibility to travel two to three days per week across the UK and Ireland to be involved in some of our most exciting flagship projects.

Your role

Project Delivery and Team Leadership

Lead major rail projects as a Senior Project Manager, or smaller rail projects as a Project Director.
Make sure projects meet revenue, profit and cash-flow targets, with clear reporting.
Lead multi-disciplinary teams, including Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers and Design Managers.
Plan resources with resource managers to make sure projects are properly supported.
Keep teams aligned on scope, programme, cost, risk, constraints and interfaces.

Governance and Commercial Management

Make sure projects meet client, governance, technical, HSE and quality requirements.
Manage project delivery and contract administration through the full project life cycle.

Team Development and Community Contribution

Share best practice and lessons learned across the project management community.
Support and mentor Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers and other team members.

Client and Business Growth

Build strong client relationships to support successful rail project delivery and win repeat work.
Support Regional Client Directors in shaping and delivering the regional rail strategy.
Lead bids for rail opportunities, with a strong focus on deliverable and well-planned solutions.

About You

Significant experience of Project Manager roles on large scale multidisciplinary UK infrastructure projects (>£5M design fees per annum) gained within a consultancy environment (through design & build contracts or design development commissions) or in applicable roles for client or contractor organisations.
Project/Engineering Management background with experience of the Heavy Rail or Light Rail/Mass Transit sector gained delivering work for clients such as Network Rail, HS2, Transport for London, Transport for Greater Manchester and Principal Contractors.
Ability to work constructively and collaboratively with clients so that AtkinsRéalis' commercial objectives are protected and met.
Good understanding of design procedures, change control, checking and review requirements.
Understanding of various forms of contract, in particular NEC3 or 4 and/or bespoke forms, and experience of deploying them.
Professional membership and recognised level of Project Management competence (eg. MAPM, MICE, PMQ, ChPP, or equivalent) – desirable.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Find out more.

Additional information

Security clearance

This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance.

We are committed to creating a culture where everyone feels that they belong - a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop to be the best we can be. So, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and employee resource groups to support all employees. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures and ability. As a Disability Confident Leader, we are committed to offering an interview to all applicants who have a disability and meet the essential criteria. If you would like to be considered under this commitment, please let us know at the application stage.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Low Voltage Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Founded in the early 2000s, we are a leading provider of low-voltage infrastructure solutions, specializing in the design, installation, and support of structured cabling, fiber optics, network infrastructure, security, wireless, and multimedia systems. With regional offices in CO, WA, UT, TX, GA, WY, and IA, we're experiencing rapid growth driven by continued investment in hyperscale data centers, AI infrastructure, and next-generation digital connectivity.
We are seeking an experienced Sr. Project Manager to lead large-scale, mission-critical hyperscale data center projects across the United States. This role requires full-time travel and is responsible for overseeing all phases of low-voltage infrastructure deployments, including structured cabling, fiber optic networks, pathway systems, equipment installation, and commissioning activities. 
The ideal candidate has a proven track record managing complex low-voltage and structured cabling projects within hyperscale or mission-critical environments, along with strong leadership, client management, and project execution skills. This role requires 100% travel. 
Key Responsibilities

Project Planning & Coordination: Lead project kickoff meetings, establish schedules, conduct site assessments, and coordinate all phases of low-voltage infrastructure installation.
Client & Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, subcontractors, field teams, and internal stakeholders. Provide regular project updates and manage customer expectations.
Budget Management: Manage project budgets, forecasts, labor planning, material costs, and overall financial performance.
Materials & Logistics Management: Coordinate procurement, delivery, staging, and inventory of structured cabling, fiber, racks, pathway systems, and related infrastructure components.
Field Operations & Manpower Planning: Oversee technician scheduling, subcontractor coordination, workforce planning, and field performance across multiple project sites.
Change Management & Documentation: Manage project schedules, milestones, RFIs, change orders, daily reports, and project documentation.
Quality, Safety & Closeout: Ensure compliance with customer standards, quality requirements, and safety protocols. Lead commissioning, turnover, client training, and project closeout activities.

Minimum Requirements

5+ years of experience in construction, structured cabling, low-voltage infrastructure, or project management leadership roles
3+ years managing large-scale low-voltage infrastructure or structured cabling deployments within mission-critical or hyperscale data center environments
Experience managing projects with budgets exceeding $500K
Strong knowledge of structured cabling systems, fiber optic infrastructure, copper cabling, pathway systems, rack & stack activities, and data center deployment best practices
Experience leading field teams, subcontractors, and cross-functional project stakeholders
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Valid Driver's License
Willingness and ability to travel full-time to job sites throughout the United States

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field
BICSI RCDD and/or DCDC certification
PMP certification
Experience supporting hyperscale data center clients such as AWS, Microsoft, Google, Meta, Oracle Cloud, or similar large-scale cloud and AI infrastructure providers

Benefits

Salary: $100-130k/year based on experience
Per Diem for full-time travel
Car & Cell Phone Allowance
401(k) with 50% employer match up to the first 4%
Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability Insurance
Health Savings & Flexible Spending Accounts
8 Paid Holidays + 3 Weeks PTO
