new_jobs.description:
Organization Overview

To embrace and honor a diversity of lived experiences, it is critical that we all listen with an open mind. We do this to translate those conversations into collective actions that lead to outcomes grounded in our longstanding mission to benefit humanity. Our understanding of humanity is inclusive of all human beings and oriented toward compassion and generosity.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Vice President for University Life and Community Engagement, the Program Manager plays a central role in building a connected, engaged, and supportive Rockefeller University community. The Program Manager develops, implements, and evaluates programs and initiatives that bring members of the University together, strengthen relationships and connections across the community, support professional and leadership development, and enhance the experience of graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, faculty, and staff. Engagement is a central focus of the position. The Program Manager develops opportunities for members of the Rockefeller community to connect with one another, participate meaningfully in the life of the University, build relationships across roles and disciplines, and contribute to a strong academic and scientific environment. The position works across the University to understand community needs, identify opportunities for connection and engagement, and translate those needs into thoughtful programs, events, learning experiences, and other initiatives. The Program Manager assesses community needs, develops programs, manages resources, evaluates outcomes, and recommends improvements based on assessment findings. The position serves as a key contributor to initiatives that strengthen community connection, professional growth, participation, and the overall University experience.

Position Responsibilities

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To, The Following

Develop, implement, manage, and assess programs and initiatives that build community, strengthen engagement and connection, and support professional and leadership development. Create opportunities for graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, faculty, staff, and other members of the University community to connect across roles, disciplines, backgrounds, and areas of the institution.
Develop and facilitate programs, events, workshops, learning experiences, and other initiatives that foster meaningful participation in University life and strengthen relationships within the Rockefeller community.
Develop and facilitate a scientific professional development curriculum or learning module that addresses topics relevant to the academic research environment, including mentoring, leadership, communication, collaboration, career development, research culture, and professional effectiveness. Apply knowledge of the scientific research environment to the design of community and professional development programs, ensuring they are relevant to the experiences and needs of scientists and scientific trainees.
Support graduate student and postdoctoral communities through programming, outreach, relationship-building, professional development, resource development, and individualized support.
Develop educational resources, facilitator guides, workshop materials, and other tools that support community engagement and the professional and leadership development of members of the University community.
Assess community needs through data collection, feedback, consultation, and program evaluation, and use findings to inform program development and decision-making. Manage multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously, ensuring timely execution and achievement of established goals and objectives.
Collaborate with campus stakeholders to identify opportunities for new programs, services, community-building efforts, professional development offerings, and engagement initiatives. Collect, analyze, and report participation, assessment, and outcome data to evaluate program effectiveness and guide continuous improvement.
Manage program budgets and resources, including monitoring expenditures and ensuring responsible stewardship of University funds. Coordinate and oversee vendors, consultants, facilitators, and external partners as needed to support program implementation.
Develop communications, newsletters, reports, presentations, educational materials, and other resources that support community engagement, professional development, and Office priorities.
Represent the Office of University Life and Community Engagement on committees, working groups, and collaborative initiatives as assigned.
Demonstrate knowledge of The Rockefeller University's mission, values, scientific environment, and strategic priorities, and incorporate them into the performance of duties.
Other duties and special projects as assigned.

Bachelor's degree and at least five (5) years of related experience.
Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, and evaluating community engagement, educational, professional development, or related programs or initiatives.
Working knowledge of the academic scientific research environment, including familiarity with the experiences and professional development needs of scientists, graduate students, or other members of the research community. Demonstrated experience creating and facilitating workshops, educational programs, professional development experiences, or community-building initiatives.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Experience managing budgets, resources, and complex projects.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with scientific and non-scientific audiences. Demonstrated ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively with faculty, scientists, staff, trainees, and other stakeholders.
Strong interpersonal, diplomacy, and relationship-building skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to use assessment and evaluation data to inform decisions.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn and use program-management and data-tracking platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in a scientific discipline, education, higher education, student affairs, organizational development, or a related field. Experience designing and facilitating professional development programs for scientists, graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, faculty, or other members of an academic research community.

About Code Metal

Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others.

The ideal candidate will have deep experience supporting Navy Authorizing Officials (AOs), working within Navy/DoD environments such as NAVWAR, NAVAIR, NAVSEA, or Fleet Cyber Command, and maintaining system authorization packages in eMASS.

The ISSM will lead the preparations and interactions with the government for system security assessments and ensure the IS maintains its Authority to Operate (ATO). The ISSM will manage the implementation of security policies, conduct risk assessments, manage security controls, and Plan of Actions and Milestones (POAM).

The ISSM is expected to advise senior management on cybersecurity issues, communicate security risks, and collaborate with technical teams and other stakeholders. The successful candidate is able to multitask; assume ownership and accountability of risks, issues, and tasks; and successfully manage and resolve those risks, issues, and tasks to completion. The successful candidate is also able to work well in a team-oriented environment; self-manage his/her own tasks; and provide hands-on guidance, direction, and mentoring to the technical team. Finally, the successful candidate is extremely well-organized, well written, has a keen eye for detail, and can clearly articulate information (both orally and in writing) to customers, stakeholders, peers, and leadership within and external to the Program and organization.

Manage system accreditation activities within eMASS and ensure data accuracy and completeness
Conduct and support security control assessments, vulnerability management, and mitigation tracking
Ensure compliance with STIGs (Security Technical Implementation Guides) and SRGs (Security Requirements Guides) from DISA
Support audits, inspections, and cybersecurity readiness reviews (e.g., FISMA, DON CIO inspections)
Provide cybersecurity guidance to engineering teams throughout system development lifecycle (SDLC), aligning with DevSecOps practices where applicable
Oversee incident response coordination in alignment with DoDI 8530.01 (Cyber Incident Response) and Navy procedures

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)

new_jobs.title: Senior Information Technology Project Manager (INSCOM)
new_jobs.description:
Description

SENIOR INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY PROJECT MANAGER

At B&A, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. B&A believes in ensuring its employees feel deeply connected to B&A, recognizing successes and hard work, and providing continuous opportunities to learn and grow. Our people are entrepreneurial thinkers that combine mindset, vision, and experience to drive value – not only to us as an organization, but to the clients we support. We promote a collaborative culture with our clients, and with each other, as one team working towards a common vision. We’d love for you to join our team!

Job Summary

B&A is seeking a Senior Information Technology Project Manager
to support the U.S. Army INSCOM Scalable GEOINT Architecture Contractor Manpower Equivalent (CME) Information Technology Support Services contract. The role supports Army GEOINT Office systems, software, security, and mission users. Primary duty location: Fort Gordon, GA.

Anticipated Award: January 2027
Anticipated Start: January 11, 2027
Period of Performance: 1 Base Year + 4 Option Years

Location

Fort Gordon, GA

Responsibilities

Plan, initiate, and manage information technology (IT) projects.
Lead and guide the work of technical staff, serving as a liaison between business and technical aspects of projects.
Plan project stages and assess business implications for each stage.
Monitor project progress to ensure deadlines, standards, and cost targets are met.
Manage project execution to ensure adherence to budget, schedule, and scope.
Collaborate with project personnel to identify and resolve problems.
Monitor and track project milestones and deliverables.
Submit project deliverables while ensuring adherence to quality standards.
Assess current and future customer needs and priorities through direct communication, surveys, or other methods.
Initiate, review, and approve modifications to project plans.
Schedule and facilitate meetings related to IT projects.
Direct and coordinate the activities of project personnel.
Develop implementation plans, including cost-benefit and return-on-investment (ROI) analyses.
Identify requirements for initial or supplemental project resources.
Develop and update project plans outlining objectives, technologies, systems, specifications, funding, and staffing.
Perform risk assessments and develop appropriate response strategies.
Prepare project status reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.
Identify, review, and select vendors or consultants to meet project needs.
Develop and manage annual budgets for IT projects.
Establish and execute project communication plans.
Develop and manage work breakdown structures (WBS) for IT projects.
Monitor project team performance and provide documented performance feedback.
Coordinate recruitment and selection of project personnel.
Assign duties, responsibilities, and authority to project personnel.
Negotiate with project stakeholders or suppliers to obtain necessary resources and materials.

Education And Experience

5–10+ years in IT project management
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
Requires a proven track record of managing large IT projects, overseeing contracts, and tracking progress.
PMP certification is required. PgMP is desired.

Security Clearance

Active TS/SCI clearance, adjudicated within the last five (5) years

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without accommodation.
Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
Frequently operate standard office equipment, including computers and telephones.
Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, video conference, and email.
Occasionally move about the office and lift up to 20 pounds.
Ability to work the assigned schedule with regular and reliable attendance.
Ability to travel up to 10% as required.

More About B&A

B&A delivers secure, innovative, and mission-critical IT solutions to support the United States Government across all three branches—Executive, Legislative, and Judicial—focused on National Security, Defense, and Intelligence. Our team of cleared professionals specializes in Agile DevSecOps, Cloud Migration and Modernization, Data Science and Analytics, Human Capital Management, Operations and Enablement, Application Transformation, All-Source Intelligence, Geospatial Production, Engineering and Integrated Services, and Cybersecurity.

Notable Clients
B&A has grown to be a company that is trusted by our clients for exceptional service, innovative solutions, and inspired employees. Our service extends through federal, state, and local Government, the private sector, and higher education. Some of our notable clients include Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, U.S. Senate, U.S. Courts, U.S. Census Bureau, U.S. Navy, and more.

B&A is proud to offer three robust individual and family medical plans to full time employees, including a Health Savings Account (HSA) option as well as two tiers of dental coverage, vision, life & AD&D, disability, accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness insurance. In addition to these benefits, B&A employees enjoy paid time off, B&A sponsored trainings and certifications, pet insurance benefits, commuter transit benefits and a free subscription to a virtual exercise platform (NEOU). B&A’s 401(k) plan is available to all employees and includes a company matching contribution.

B&A has launched several programs to focus on employee engagement, wellness, and assistance. These include:

The B&A Cares program: 30/60/90-day wellness check ins, personal development, financial management, and stress management seminars, and more
A formal mentorship program
Job shadowing and cross training opportunities
Brand Ambassador program
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access to various support resources to include counseling, legal guidance, financial planning, and more
Monthly teambuilding events
B&A Annual Wellness Challenges: #StepWithB&A, #WalkDuringLunchWithB&A, #VolunteeringWithB&A, #ExerciseDuringLunchWithB&A, and more

At B&A, we place significant importance on improving the communities and lives of citizens across the nation through our involvement, technology expertise, and employees. B&A puts an emphasis on charitable efforts in the Northern Virginia area, including Capital Area Food Bank pantry drives, book donations, Hope for Henry Foundation events, and many more. In recognition of all these efforts, B&A has been named a Companies as Responsive Employers (CARE) award recipient by Northern Virginia Family Services and nominated by the Northern Virginia Chamber of Commerce for Outstanding Corporate Citizenship Award.

EEO

B&A provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. B&A complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy covers conduct occurring at B&A’s offices, and other workplaces (including client sites) and all other locations where B&A is providing services, and to all work-related activities.

EEO is the Law

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Are you a Project Manager who knows how to keep things moving, bring people together and navigate challenges without losing sight of the bigger picture?
We're looking for an experienced Project Manager to join Orion Health on a 12-month fixed-term contract!
In this role, you'll manage a portfolio of healthcare technology projects, working closely with customers and internal teams to deliver successful outcomes.
You'll be stepping into an established portfolio of customer relationships and projects, including work with some of New Zealand's leading healthcare organisations. From managing multiple smaller workstreams to overseeing larger implementation projects, you'll need to be comfortable juggling competing priorities while keeping stakeholders informed and engaged.
We're looking for someone who brings a practical, flexible approach to project management. Someone who can confidently manage scope, timelines and deliverables, while recognising that strong relationships and open communication are just as important as the project plan.
What you'll be doing:

Managing multiple healthcare technology projects from planning through to delivery.
Coordinating project activities, resources, timelines and budgets to ensure successful outcomes.
Building and maintaining strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
Managing project scope, risks, issues and changing requirements with a pragmatic approach.
Facilitating clear communication between customers, technical teams and other stakeholders.
Balancing competing priorities across multiple projects and workstreams.
Taking ownership of project delivery while working collaboratively to resolve challenges.

About You

We're looking for an experienced Project Manager who combines strong delivery skills with excellent stakeholder management and a genuine ability to build trust.
Ideally, you'll bring:
4+ years of experience managing software implementation, IT or technology projects.
Experience managing multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trusted customer relationships.
Excellent communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
The confidence to take ownership, make decisions and know when to seek input or escalate.
A flexible, solutions-focused approach and the ability to adapt as priorities change.
Strong organisational skills and the ability to keep projects on track without being overly reliant on rigid processes.

Experience in healthcare IT or health technology would be a bonus, but isn't essential. We're equally interested in hearing from Project Managers who have successfully delivered complex technology projects in other industries.
Formal project management certifications such as PRINCE2 or PMP are welcome, but they're not a requirement.
What matters most is your ability to build relationships, communicate with empathy and deliver results. You'll know when to challenge, when to listen and how to find solutions that work for everyone involved.
A little about us

Orion Health is a global healthcare technology company headquartered in New Zealand, with more than 30 years of experience developing technology that helps healthcare organisations securely connect, manage, and make sense of complex health data. Our solutions support healthcare organisations around the world, helping to improve access to information, streamline care, and deliver better outcomes for patients.
Orion Health is also a part of HEALWELL AI, a publicly listed healthcare AI company focused on preventative care and the early identification and detection of disease. HEALWELL's ecosystem brings together healthcare AI, data, interoperability and software capabilities, with a shared mission to improve healthcare and save lives through technology.
Together, Orion Health and HEALWELL AI are at an exciting stage of growth, combining Orion Health's global healthcare technology and data infrastructure with HEALWELL's AI capabilities to help deliver smarter, more connected healthcare.
Why you'll love working here

Our offices are energetic hubs packed with fun - think foosball, pool table, arcade games and a PlayStation.
Hybrid working lets you design your day around collaboration and flexibility.
We provide free breakfast, fruit, and barista-grade coffee every day - plus an onsite café so you don't need to venture far!

We use a secure platform with AI tools that help organise applications fairly and efficiently. All hiring decisions are made by humans, and your data is handled per applicable privacy laws. For additional privacy information, see our  Privacy Statement.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Transportation PDP Rail and Transit)
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Be trusted to make great things happen.

You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We're proud to say it's thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise and knowledge. And when you join us, you'll be a part of this genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone's voice is valued and treated equally.

AtkinsRéalis Transportation Project Delivery Practice (PDP) is the centre of excellence for the delivery of major transportation infrastructure projects and combines the best in project management and design management to provide a full suite of services to clients in the public and private sectors. The team is responsible for delivery of design services across our markets of Rail and Transit, Highways and Local Transport, and lean out into other sectors including Defence and Nuclear. We have a wide client base including HS2, National Highways, Network Rail, Irish Rail, Local Authorities, as well as several Principal Contractors.

This is an exciting opportunity within the PDP Rail and Transit team for an experienced Senior Project Manager looking to lead the successful delivery of our projects, influence the growth and development of the project management team and progress into a Project Director role.

With a home office in Manchester, Birmingham, Derby or Stockton-on-Tees, this role requires flexibility to travel two to three days per week across the UK and Ireland to be involved in some of our most exciting flagship projects.

Your role

Project Delivery and Team Leadership

Lead major rail projects as a Senior Project Manager, or smaller rail projects as a Project Director.
Make sure projects meet revenue, profit and cash-flow targets, with clear reporting.
Lead multi-disciplinary teams, including Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers and Design Managers.
Plan resources with resource managers to make sure projects are properly supported.
Keep teams aligned on scope, programme, cost, risk, constraints and interfaces.

Governance and Commercial Management

Make sure projects meet client, governance, technical, HSE and quality requirements.
Manage project delivery and contract administration through the full project life cycle.

Team Development and Community Contribution

Share best practice and lessons learned across the project management community.
Support and mentor Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers and other team members.

Client and Business Growth

Build strong client relationships to support successful rail project delivery and win repeat work.
Support Regional Client Directors in shaping and delivering the regional rail strategy.
Lead bids for rail opportunities, with a strong focus on deliverable and well-planned solutions.

About You

Significant experience of Project Manager roles on large scale multidisciplinary UK infrastructure projects (>£5M design fees per annum) gained within a consultancy environment (through design & build contracts or design development commissions) or in applicable roles for client or contractor organisations.
Project/Engineering Management background with experience of the Heavy Rail or Light Rail/Mass Transit sector gained delivering work for clients such as Network Rail, HS2, Transport for London, Transport for Greater Manchester and Principal Contractors.
Ability to work constructively and collaboratively with clients so that AtkinsRéalis' commercial objectives are protected and met.
Good understanding of design procedures, change control, checking and review requirements.
Understanding of various forms of contract, in particular NEC3 or 4 and/or bespoke forms, and experience of deploying them.
Professional membership and recognised level of Project Management competence (eg. MAPM, MICE, PMQ, ChPP, or equivalent) – desirable.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Find out more.

Additional information

Security clearance

This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance.

We are committed to creating a culture where everyone feels that they belong - a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop to be the best we can be. So, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and employee resource groups to support all employees. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures and ability. As a Disability Confident Leader, we are committed to offering an interview to all applicants who have a disability and meet the essential criteria. If you would like to be considered under this commitment, please let us know at the application stage.

new_jobs.description:
PRINT

Intelligence analyst/quality control analyst

15.10.2026 New opportunity

Teaser

Deadline for sending application:
05/11/2026at 12.00 noon (CET)
.

Text

WE ARE

The European External Action Service (EEAS) is the European Union’s diplomatic service. Since 2011, the EEAS carries out the EU’s Common Foreign and Security Policy (CFSP) to promote peace, prosperity, security, and the interests of the EU across the globe. It brings together European civil servants, diplomats from EU Member States, national experts and local staff worldwide.

The EEAS supports the High Representative in the exercise of her mandate to steer the Union’s CFSP, including the Common Security and Defence Policy (CSDP), to represent the EU on issues relating to the CFSP and to chair the Foreign Affairs Council. It also supports her as Vice-President of the Commission with regard to her responsibilities within the Commission, including the coordination of other aspects of the EU’s external action. The EEAS works in close cooperation with the EU Member States, the General Secretariat of the Council, the services of the Commission and the Secretariat General of the European Parliament.

The EEAS Headquarters are in Brussels. It is also responsible for the management of the network of 145 Union Delegations and Offices worldwide. These Diplomatic Representations play a vital role in representing the EU in the country where they are based, in promoting the values and interests of the EU, and in building networks and partnerships. They are responsible for all policy areas of the relationship between the EU and the host country/organisation.

The EU Intelligence and Situation Centre (EU INTCEN) is the exclusive civilian intelligence centre of the EU, providing in-depth analysis for decision makers in all EU Institutions. As such, EU INTCEN is a directorate of the EEAS that is directly attached to the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy and Vice-President of the European Commission. It comprises an Intelligence Analysis Division (INTCEN.1) and a Support/Open-Source Research Division (INTCEN.2).

EU INTCEN also offers its services to the various EU decision-making bodies in the fields of the EU Common Foreign and Security Policy (CFSP), Common Security Defence policy (CSDP) and Counter Terrorism, as well as to the Member States. Under the Single Intelligence Analysis Capacity (SIAC) agreement, it works hand in hand with its military counterpart, the EUMS INT, in order to deliver joint civilian and military intelligence assessments.

WE PROPOSE

The Position Of Intelligence Analyst/quality Control Analyst- Contract Agent FGIV As Per Article 3b Of The Conditions Of Employment Of Other Servants Of The European Union (hereafter, The “CEOS”). The Successful Candidate Will

anticipate relevant developments and customer needs in the respective geographic or thematic area of the Division and provide, at own initiative or as requested, intelligence analysis;
be responsible for quality control of intelligence products of the Division;
contribute to the work program of the Single Intelligence Analysis Capacity;
contribute to transforming the Division's objectives into activities and actions and assist the Head of Division in fulfilling their mandate in accordance with existing regulations.

Subject to having passed the CAST exam, the successful candidate will be offered a contract agent position (Function group IV), as per Article 3b of the CEOS, on the basis of a contract with an initial duration of one year. This contract may be successively renewed up to a maximum duration of six years, subject to the maximum duration of engagement by the EEAS allowed under successive limited duration contracts of different types.

PLACE and DATE OF EMPLOYMENT

‎EEAS Headquarters, Brussels, Belgium

Post available:
01/11/2026

LEGAL BASIS FOR RECRUITMENT TO THIS POSITION

The vacancy is to be filled in accordance with the conditions stipulated under the CEOS, in particular Article 82 thereof.

WE LOOK FOR

Skills

A dynamic, proactive and highly motivated colleague with very good analytical and organisational skills and with a developed sense of service. He/she will be entrusted with the following main tasks:

proactively monitor geographic and thematic developments relevant to the Division’s task;
analyse and assess relevant data required for specific inquiries, verifications and/or controls carried out;
draft comprehensive analysis reports and/or updates to existing ones;
perform quality control of the Division’s products in terms of structure, clarity, brevity, objectivity, adherence to structural formatting guidelines, consistency in reporting and political sensitivity. Provide constructive feedback to colleague analysts and help them improve their analytical and writing skills;
contribute to maintaining contacts with relevant organisational structures of the EEAS, the General Secretariat of the Council, Member States, the Commission and other international players as appropriate;
develop and maintain contacts with EU stakeholders on working level in the different institutions, agencies and bodies;
contribute to the Single Intelligence Analysis Capacity (SIAC) work programme.

Eligibility criteria

In Addition To The Conditions Set Out In Article 82 Of The CEOS And In The Commission Decision C(2017) 6760 Final , Which Is Applicable To The EEAS By Virtue Of The Decision ADMIN(2018) 4 Of The High Representative, Candidates Must

have passed a valid EPSO CAST in FG IV, or be registered in the EPSO Permanent CAST for FG IV (https://eu-careers.europa.eu/en/contract-staff-selection-procedures-always-open-registration). In the latter case, while the registration will make the candidate eligible for the selection procedure, the recruitment of a candidate on this vacant post will be subject to his/her successfully passing the CAST exam;
have completed university studies of at least three years attested by a diploma;
have the capacity to work in the languages of the CFSP and external relations (English and French) necessary for the performance of their duties;
be a national of one of the Member States of the European Union and enjoy full rights as a citizen.

Selection criteria

Candidates Should Have

a profound background in intelligence analysis within an EU Member State intelligence or security organisation of at least 4 years;
strong drafting, communication and analytical skills combined with sound judgement;
an excellent ability to maintain diplomatic relations and to ensure representation, communication and management in a complex, multicultural environment;
an excellent capacity to create constructive working relations with national authorities, civil society, international organisations and EU Member States;
excellent knowledge of the EU's internal and external policies and instruments, and of the functioning of the Union and its inter-institutional framework;
experience and knowledge of CFSP and CSDP;
a working proficiency in English and a sufficient level of French (reading and/or understanding);
strong service attitude;
be a flexible team player.

Furthermore

experience of working in a team in a multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural environment;
experience in working with or within other EU institutions;
experience in quality control of intelligence products in terms of structure, clarity, brevity, objectivity, adherence to structural formatting guidelines, consistency in reporting and political sensitivity

will be considered as strong assets.

CONDITIONS OF RECRUITMENT AND EMPLOYMENT

CONFLICT OF INTEREST AND SECURITY RISKS

As a matter of policy, applications by individuals who have dual nationality, of which one of a non-EU country, will be considered on a case-by-case basis taking account in particular of the functions attributed to the vacant post. The EEAS also examines if there could be a conflict of interest or security risks.

In this context, all candidates shall fill with their application a declaration of potential conflict of interest
(see attached).

MEDICAL CLEARANCE

The signature of the contract will be subject to prior favourable opinion of the Medical Service, unless the successful candidate is a temporary agent currently employed in the EEAS.

PERSONNEL SECURITY CLEARANCE
(hereafter, “PSC”)

The requested level of security clearance for this post is: SECRET UE/EU SECRET. A description of the EU classified information levels is available under Article 2 of Annex A of the Decision ADMIN(2023) 18 on the security rules of the EEAS.

Given the specific role of the INTCEN and the sensitive nature of the tasks pertaining to the offered position which requires candidates to have already gained an experience in handling EUCI documents, a valid Personnel Security Clearance (hereafter, the “PSC”) issued by the competent authority of their Member State in accordance with national laws and regulations is mandatory at the moment of application in order to enter the selection process.

The selected candidate may still be required to obtain a new PSC for the present post in accordance with national laws and regulations of his or her Member State and with the procedure laid down in the Decision ADMIN(2025) 42 on Implementing Rules and Procedures for Personnel Security measures for protection of EU Classified Information of 20 November 2025 and in Annex A I of the Decision ADMIN(2023) 18 on the security rules of the EEAS. Until the new PSC is issued, the selected candidate may not be authorised to access EUCI at the level of CONFIDENTIEL UE/EU CONFIDENTIAL or above, or to participate in any meetings or workflow where EUCI is processed.

Please note that the necessary procedure for obtaining a PSC can be initiated on request of the employer only, and not by the individual candidate.

In case of failure to obtain or renew the required PSC, the AACC may take the appropriate measures in accordance with Article 7 of the Decision ADMIN(2025) 42 on Implementing Rules and Procedures for Personnel Security measures for protection of EU Classified Information of 20 November 2025.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

The EEAS strives to be a dynamic, respectful and inclusive Service. We value the talent and professional excellence of our staff, and are committed to building an organisation where gender equality and the respect of diversity are core values, as set out in the EEAS Mission Statement and the EEAS Agenda for Diversity and Inclusion. The EEAS is committed to achieving gender balance within its workforce and strives to avoid any form of discrimination during this selection procedure, as per Article 1(d) of the SR. We actively welcome applications from all qualified candidates without any discrimination based on any ground. We commit to recruit candidates with the highest standard of ability, efficiency and integrity, carrying out a selection based on merits required for the post and from the broadest possible geographical basis among the EU Member States.

The EEAS is committed to working with people with disabilities in the terms of the SR. If, by virtue of your medical condition or special needs, you require reasonable accommodation for a part or the entirety of this selection process, please send us an email to CONTRACTAGENTS-HQ@eeas.europa.eu. Your request will be treated in strict confidence and no record will be kept. If a candidate with a disability is selected for a vacant post, the EEAS is committed to providing reasonable accommodation in accordance with Article 1(d)(4) of the SR.

All selected candidates are expected to adhere to the Principles of Professional Behaviour of the EEAS, which outline the need for integrity, transparency, respect, professionalism and accountability, and a zero tolerance approach to any form of harassment.

APPLICATION AND SELECTION PROCEDURE

new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: London

About The Team

The Cloudflare Data Intelligence & Analytics (DIA) team has built a unified data & ML platform to provide our internal Business Partners with actionable analytics, insights, and recommendations.

Our goals are to:

Democratize data & intelligence for humans and agents
Build a context layer and an AI systems layer upon our unified data & content platform
Support Cloudflare’s critical business needs

DIA is a : 75-member strong geographically distributed but organizationally centralized team. This role is within the growth & adoption analytics pod based in London that works across several business functions, offering broad exposure to Cloudflare's entire business.

Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst in London to scale our growth & adoption analytics initiatives. You will be a trusted data advisor to our business partners, a technical coach to your peers, and the lead in terms of shaping AI-first data models, workflows, and agent-ready-datasets.

Success in this role will rely on marrying a strong analytics background with product and business acumen to deliver highly strategic and compelling insights that accelerate growth and influence adoption. This role also requires a deep understanding of data infrastructure, job orchestration, and lineage, all with the use of AI-tooling as default.

Role Responsibilities

Own the development and maintenance of agent-ready curated datasets end-to-end
Provide analytics support and a strategic perspective to our business partners
Partner with data engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to enable data-driven answers to key business problems
Review Merge Requests created by your team of humans and agents
Take initiative to gather requirements, define, build, and maintain pipelines and metrics
Tell easily digestible and highly actionable stories with data to help stakeholders understand analytical insights

Role Requirements

B.S. or M.S in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or other quantitative fields
Demonstrable proficiency with analytics-relevant AI-tooling
4+ years experience in a centralized data analytics teams in close partnership with business stakeholders
Expert-level proficiency in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries is mandatory, with a proven ability to performance-tune complex queries and manage analysis workflows against large, petabyte-scale datasets (Candidates will be assessed on advanced SQL skills including window functions and common table expressions (CTEs))
3+ years experience working in version control environments using platforms such as Gitlab or Github
2+ years experience working with job orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, both as a pipeline developer and reviewer
2+ years experience with data ingestion and transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt, Fivetran, or custom/in-house developed platforms)
Initiative, curiosity, strong stakeholder engagement, and empathy
Experience translating business questions into analysis frameworks, converting results into business recommendations, and presenting those to stakeholders

Nice-to-Have Experience

Experience and/or a keen interest in internet security, protocols, and edge-development
Analytics experience in a fast-growing technology, SaaS, or subscription-based business
Experience with statistical analysis programming languages (Python, R etc.)

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

Dashboards are accurate, adopted, and used regularly by their intended audience.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Talent Bridge
: Data Analytics & Business Intelligence

Location
: Research Engineering Campus, Idaho National Laboratory

Schedule
: 9-80s with every other Friday off

Program Duration
: 12 months, with a potential 1-year extension.

Position Overview

Idaho National Laboratory (INL) is seeking a motivated Data Analyst to support the Environment, Safety, Health & Quality (ESH&Q) Process and Data Systems team through the Talent Bridge program. This role offers a unique opportunity to apply data science, analytics, and visualization techniques to enhance the systems, processes, and insights that help ensure a safe, compliant, and high-performing work environment across INL.

As a Data Analyst, you will harness statistical modeling and analytical methods to transform complex data into actionable insights that support ESH&Q programs, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives. You will work with stakeholders across ESH&Q, Information Management, and laboratory operations to understand business needs, develop technical requirements, and deliver data-driven solutions that improve decision-making and organizational performance.

Your work will support the collection, analysis, visualization, and interpretation of data related to safety performance, quality metrics, operational processes, risk management, and organizational effectiveness. Through advanced analytics and data storytelling, you will help leaders identify trends, assess performance indicators, and drive informed decisions that strengthen INL's mission of advancing nuclear energy, national security, and scientific innovation.

Essential Job Functions And Responsibilities:

Perform statistical modeling and analysis of structured and unstructured datasets to develop metrics, reports, and visualizations of trends and patterns.
Work with technology organizations and business end-users to understand data and analysis needs and develop technical requirements.
Partner with development and data management roles to identify and capture data required from internal and external sources.
Create and maintain statistical models for ongoing and ad hoc review and analysis of data.
Use data visualization programs, tools, and techniques to generate dashboards, reports, and presentations that aid in data storytelling, understanding, and interpretation of trends and patterns of business importance.
May be internal or external, client-focused, working in conjunction with Professional Services and outsourcing functions. May include company-wide, web-enabled solutions.

Minimum Qualifications:

To qualify, you must have completed your BS in a related field in Data Science or a closely related field within the last 12 months.
Experience in data science, data analysis, and software development using C#, Java, or C++.
Experience with cloud services and cloud-based analytics is a plus (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.).

Application Requirements:

Current Resume or CV; Proof of Graduation (diploma or unofficial transcript accepted)
Proof of Graduation (diploma or unofficial transcripts accepted)

Program Benefits:

Mentored environment providing post-degree work experience.
Opportunities for professional development and training.

Depending on the assigned directorate, may be required to obtain and maintain a Q level security clearance.
Knowledge of Python, SciPy, Notebook IDE, PyTorch, Cuda, Natural Language Processing Techniques, Graph Databases, Relational Databases, and a general understanding of data storage and processing.

Application Requirements:

Program Benefits: Mentored environment, professional development opportunities, accelerated knowledge transfer from retiring staff

Introduction

The Maryland Department of General Services (DGS) supports State and local government agencies, as well as local non-profit organizations and the citizens of Maryland, by providing facilities management, real estate and surplus property services, as well as security and law enforcement for State buildings. DGS is also responsible for a full spectrum of facilities, engineering, design and construction services, almost $1 billion in annual contract administration, and overseeing the State procurement process. Here at DGS, we truly Do Great Service… Consider joining our team!

This is a Management Service position which serves at the pleasure of the Appointing Authority (“at-will”).

GRADE

20

LOCATION OF POSITION

DGS Business Enterprise Administration

301 W. Preston St.

Baltimore, MD 21201

This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule.

Main Purpose of Job

The Capital Grants Compliance Manager oversees post-award compliance processes for the Capital Grants and Loans program. The position ensures that the CGL team maintains internal controls, clear processes, and consistent compliance practices for all grants and contracts. This role serves as the policy and process owner, maintaining the playbook, checklists, and templates for compliance activities. The focus of this position is to ensure that the financial, programmatic, and administrative requirements of all grants are followed and that the organization always remains audit ready. The incumbent must possess experience and working knowledge of residential/commercial construction, experience conducting property inspections, experience with grant compliance activities, and strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting valuation findings.

POSITION DUTIES

Duties To Include But Not Limited To

Grant Compliance and Oversight : Develops organizational practices, policies and processes for documenting grant information and activities, including audits. Provides expertise on grant compliance and interpretation of all applicable regulations, policies, and procedures in collaboration with the appropriate internal and external stakeholders. Interprets applicable regulations and translates into operational policies as required. Oversees the Construction Compliance Officer and Inspector(s). Reviews grant files to ensure completeness and accuracy. Advises the CGL Director on process improvements to meet compliance expectations. Collaborate with stakeholders across institutional departments to resolve compliance risks and implement corrective actions.
Communication and Reporting: Maintains and monitors a Compliance Calendar for reporting deadlines, site visits, and legislative reports. Tracks compliance issues and findings, ensuring corrective actions areimplemented and resolved. Develops, updates, and delivers training materials and guidance on grantcompliance to internal and external stakeholders. Develops and distributes monthly and quarterly compliance and payment reporting.
Site Visits and Payments: Reviews and evaluates contracts and construction plans for compliance with state bond requirements. Conducts project site visits during and post-award for compliance and project closeout. Reviews and approves invoices and payment requests for accuracy and validity.

Desired Or Preferred Qualifications

Strong preference will be given to applicants who possess the following preferred qualification(s) . Include clear and specific information on your application regarding all qualifications.

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Business Administration, Public Administration, Construction Management, Finance, Real Estate, Civil Engineering, or a closely related field.
Five (5) years of professional experience in grant administration, financial/contract compliance, or regulatory oversight.
At least two (2) years of experience must involve: working knowledge of residential or commercial construction practices, plan reviews, or contract evaluation.
Direct experience conducting physical property/project site inspections to verify progress and compliance. Developing or enforcing internal controls, compliance playbooks, checklists, or audit readiness procedures.
Experience supervising technical, inspection, or compliance personnel (e.g., Construction Compliance Officers or Inspectors).
Experience managing public capital grant/loan programs and interacting with state oversight entities, legislative bodies, or administrative boards (e.g., Board of Public Works, Comptroller, Department of Budget & Management).
Working knowledge of state bond requirements, state/federal grant regulations, and statutory reporting deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to document formal valuation/inspection findings and draft policy recommendations for executive leadership.

SELECTION PROCESS

It is important that you provide complete and accurate information on your application.Please include all experience and education that is related to this position.All information concerning your qualifications must be submitted by the closing date; information submitted after the closing date will not be considered.Credit is given for relevant part-time, temporary or volunteer experience based on the number of hours worked per week; you must include the time spent on such activities on your application.

Note that for any position requiring a college degree or college credit, you will be required to submit a college transcript prior to being offered a position.You may submit your transcript as part of the application process.

Please note that selected candidates may be required to complete and successfully pass a State and Federal fingerprint background check prior to being hired.

You must be legally authorized under the United States Immigration Reform and Control Act to be hired in the position for which you apply.

Tuition reimbursement, if funding is available, for those who qualify
Flexible work schedules and telework opportunities for many positions
Free mass transit in Baltimore & Annapolis
Generous paid leave that increases with years of service
Paid holidays
Health coverage with low out-of-pocket costs
Employee & employer contributory pension plan

Click on the link below for more information.

State Of Maryland Benefits

in the subject line.

The Junior Operations Analyst supports the General Operations Team by completing assigned operational, reporting, referral intake, data review, client-service, and project-related tasks accurately and within required timelines. This entry-level role requires attention to detail, clear communication, sound follow-through, and the ability to follow documented procedures while developing practical knowledge of internal systems, client platforms, reporting processes, and operational outcomes. Process assigned operational work, including referral intake, service and firm transfers, mailbox monitoring, status reports, exception data clean-up, and related follow-up.
Retrieve, prepare, and support client and internal reporting materials, including client status reports, MBR presentation templates, dashboards, daily reports, monthly reporting, and other assigned deliverables; format, customize, or otherwise prepare data from internal systems or external platforms for presentation, review, or analysis as required.
Conduct preliminary quality assurance reviews of assigned reports, data, and operational processes prior to delivery to support accuracy, relevance, completeness, and timely completion.
Identify aged items, data inconsistencies, basic exceptions, or process gaps within assigned work; escalate concerns to leadership or appropriate stakeholders; and provide reporting, data review, and follow-up support to improve productivity and system performance as needed.
Build professional working relationships with internal stakeholders and report users through clear communication, proactive follow-up, and support of service expectations.
Develop a working understanding of foreclosure, bankruptcy, firm structure, departmental functions, assigned report outcomes, and the operational purpose of assigned work.
Maintain accurate records, reporting instructions, and training materials for assigned work to ensure related procedures remain current, complete, and aligned with approved process updates.

Required Skills And Competencies

Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete assigned work accurately and within required deadlines.
Ability to follow documented procedures, maintain organized working notes or reporting instructions, work independently after training, manage multiple priorities, and seek clarification when direction, information, instruction, or resources are needed to meet deadlines and required outcomes.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate questions, risks, delays, and needed follow-up in a timely and professional manner.
Basic analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to recognize trends, exceptions, inconsistencies, and potential process concerns in assigned work.
Basic Excel skills, including sorting, filtering, formatting, and simple formulas, with willingness to develop pivot table, dashboard, and reporting skills over time.
Moderate computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office, Word, PowerPoint, internal systems, client platforms, and legal databases.
General understanding of legal terminology, foreclosure processes, bankruptcy workflows, or creditor rights operations preferred.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree preferred; relevant certification, training, or equivalent experience related to the position will also be considered.
Entry-level candidates will be considered; training will be provided for firm-specific systems, reporting processes, operational workflows, and assigned responsibilities, with prior experience in operations, legal support, financial analysis, reporting, foreclosure, bankruptcy, or creditor rights work preferred but not required.

Consistently delivers assigned work on time, maintains quality through appropriate review, and follows through without repeated prompting.

.

OVERVIEW OF ROLE

The Data Analyst – Fire
acquires, manages, integrates, analyzes, and reports Aurora Fire Rescue (AFR) operational data to support department operations, performance measurement, regulatory reporting, and informed decision-making. The position performs data ingestion, validation, quality assurance, transformation, and integration across multiple public safety systems; develops recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and analyses; and supports statistical, geospatial, and predictive analytics initiatives.

Data Systems Management & Quality Assurance
:

Maintain and support AFR data and reporting functions within public safety information systems, including CAD, RMS, NERIS, and related databases

Ensure data accuracy and reliability for leadership decisions and regulatory compliance (e.g., NERIS incident reporting)

Data Integration & Compliance Reporting:

Develop and maintain data integrations between systems (CAD, RMS, NERIS) to ensure consistent, high-quality data across all sources

Collaborate with operational personnel and subject-matter experts to define data requirements, validate analytical assumptions, and ensure reports and analyses accurately reflect AFR operations

Data Analysis & Reporting:

Generate regular and ad-hoc reports and dashboards to meet identified operational needs
Use SQL and business intelligence tools to extract, combine, and analyze data from multiple sources, identifying trends and patterns
Present clear findings and visualizations that provide stakeholders with timely, accurate information for decision-making, performance monitoring, and service improvements
Develop and maintain documentation for data definitions, queries, validation rules, reporting methodologies, integrations, and recurring analytical processes

Operational Analytics Support:

Perform statistical and trend analyses on data to identify operational patterns, risks, and areas for improvement
Summarize data insights and assist the Data Analytics Supervisor in developing data-driven recommendations for crews, command staff, and executive leadership
Support the development, testing, validation, and application of predictive and forecasting tools used to evaluate incident demand and operational trends

GIS And Special Projects:

Provide updates and analysis of AFR GIS data
Assist in evaluating and implementing new data-related technologies and tools

Other Duties:

Perform other job-related duties as assigned

This job description is not intended to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new additions may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS & WORKING CONDITIONS

An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that demonstrates required knowledge, skills, and abilities may be considered.

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Public Administration with an emphasis in quantitative analysis, or a closely related field

Experience:

Three (3) years of progressively responsible experience in data analysis, data management, business intelligence, or a closely related field, including experience working with large datasets and integrating or analyzing data from multiple sources

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with data analysis in public safety, fire service, or emergency management
Familiarity with public safety data systems (e.g., CAD, RMS) and geographic information systems (GIS) is highly desirable

Knowledge Of:

Principles, best practices, and statistical methods used in data analysis and performance measurement
Data quality assurance, validation, governance, and integrity practices
Relational database concepts, data structures, and SQL
Principles and methods of data visualization and dashboard development
Data integration concepts and methods for combining information from multiple systems
Applicable fire and emergency response data standards and reporting requirements, including NERIS
Principles and practices of geospatial analysis and GIS
Data privacy, confidentiality, and appropriate handling of sensitive or restricted information

Skills In:

Querying, extracting, transforming, validating, and analyzing data using SQL and related analytical tools
Identifying and resolving data quality issues
Developing and maintaining reports, dashboards, visualizations, and other analytical products
Analyzing large and complex datasets from multiple sources
Applying statistical and trend-analysis techniques to operational data
Using spreadsheet and business intelligence tools to organize, analyze, validate, and present information
Translating complex data into clear, accessible visualizations and narratives for technical and nontechnical audiences
Preparing and delivering clear written and oral presentations of analytical findings
Troubleshooting data, reporting, and integration issues

Ability To:

Establish and maintain effective working relationships with department personnel, City staff, other governmental agencies, vendors, and other stakeholders
Interpret operational needs and translate business questions into appropriate data and analytical approaches
Manage multiple assignments, priorities, and deadlines with appropriate attention to accuracy and detail
Exercise sound judgment when working with sensitive, confidential, or restricted information
Communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences
Work independently while collaborating effectively with operational and technical subject-matter experts
Learn and apply emerging analytical technologies, tools, and methodologies

Valid Colorado driver’s license and ability to operate a city vehicle, or otherwise demonstrate ability to meet the transportation requirements of the position

When a local announcement of emergency or disaster is declared by the city, all City of Aurora employees may be required to work as essential personnel.

Occasional walking, standing, lifting, and carrying
Ability to review and interpret reports and other written documents with or without reasonable accommodation
Ability to communicate with employees, opposing council, and other stakeholders with or without reasonable accommodation

Work Environment:

Works primarily in an indoor office setting with regular computer and phone use
Occasionally off-site or outdoor work (e.g., at emergency scenes or training events) with potential exposure to noise, weather, smoke, dust, or odors

Equipment Used:

Uses standard office equipment including personal computer and common office software such as email, internet, Word, Excel and menu driven databases
This position may require the incumbent to use personal equipment (e.g. vehicle, cell phone, etc.) in the course of their employment

At Grow, the work you do can literally change someone's life. Your work here doesn't stay on a screen; it impacts whether someone can find, afford, and access quality care. That ambition sets us apart, and offers you an endless runway to impact one of the world's most urgent issues. We don’t have passenger seats here. Everyone is driving something that matters.

This work deserves real commitment. So if you thrive on meeting problems head on, untangling serious complexity, and working at pace with the sharpest yet kindest people around, you've come to the right place.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Sr. Data Analyst to help us drive data-driven insights and reporting in Product at Grow Therapy, and who will work on a variety of reporting, analytics and experimentation projects. You’ll join a broader data organization of analysts, data scientists, and data engineers, and be part of an Analytics team reporting into an Analytics Manager. This role will support our Lives Covered product group, focused on Billing & Payments features.

What You’ll Be Doing

Partner with Product and other technical stakeholders to prioritize analytical needs and support product launches, decision-making, and ad hoc requests through clear, data-driven insights.
Develop, maintain, and evolve core product and performance reporting, including business-critical dashboards built on scalable, reliable datasets.
Support experimentation and A/B testing through thoughtful design, execution, analysis, and clear, actionable conclusions.
Create compelling data visualizations and storytelling assets to effectively communicate insights to diverse audiences.
Collaborate with stakeholders on complex, high-impact analytical projects, including data modeling and OKR development.
Work closely with data scientists and data engineers to improve data availability, integrity, accuracy, reliability, and logging/pipeline quality.
Identify business-critical opportunities to improve claims collection and reduce billing friction.

You’ll Be a Good Fit If

You have 5+ years proven experience in using analytics to tackle business problems that cross multiple product/project areas and teams, ideally in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.

You are a wizard at building business critical dashboards/data visualizations (ideally within Hex).
You have experience with data modeling (dbt) or are eager to learn.

You enjoy communicating effectively and building relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You deeply value the importance of expanding access to mental health care.

new_jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Enterprise Data Analyst
to lead the design, development, and governance of enterprise reporting across a complex Wealth Management ecosystem. This role is responsible for ensuring data integrity, consistency, and transparency across multiple reporting systems while enabling actionable insights for executive decision-making.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in data modeling, data reconciliation, and reporting architecture, along with a strong understanding of data flows across custodians, clearing firms, portfolio accounting platforms, and CRM systems. This role will partner closely with business leaders, technology teams, and data stakeholders to standardize reporting and drive data-driven decision making.

Key Responsibilities

Data Modeling & Architecture

Design and maintain scalable data models to support enterprise reporting across KPI, AUM/AUA, revenue, and advisor performance metrics
Define and standardize data structures, relationships, and hierarchies across multiple reporting systems
Partner with IT and data engineering teams to ensure optimal data pipelines and reporting architecture

Data Integrity & Governance

Establish and enforce data governance standards, including definitions, lineage, and validation processes
Lead reconciliation of data across multiple systems (custodians, clearing firms, CRM, portfolio accounting) to ensure accuracy and completeness
Identify and resolve data discrepancies, proactively improving data quality and controls
Document data sources, transformations, and reporting logic to ensure transparency and auditability

Reporting & Analytics

Develop and enhance enterprise reporting frameworks for KPIs, AUM/AUA, revenue, net flows, business performance, and data governance
Build dynamic dashboards and reporting solutions using tools such as Power BI, Excel data models, or similar platforms
Standardize KPI definitions and reporting outputs to ensure consistency across business units and leadership reporting
Deliver both recurring and ad hoc reporting with a focus on clarity, accuracy, and timeliness

Insights & Decision Support

Analyze financial and operational trends (e.g., net new assets, retention, revenue growth) to generate actionable insights
Partner with senior leadership to translate data into strategic recommendations and business actions
Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, automation, and scalability

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Serve as a key liaison between Business, Technology, Operations, and Finance teams
Support enterprise initiatives (e.g., platform transitions, mergers, reporting transformations) by aligning data and reporting requirements
Drive adoption of standardized reporting practices across the organization

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field
5+ years of experience in business analytics, reporting, or data management (preferably in Wealth Management or Financial Services)
Advanced expertise in Microsoft Excel (data modeling, Power Query, PivotTables)
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools
Strong understanding of data modeling concepts (star schema, relational data, normalization)
Experience working with large, complex datasets across multiple systems
Familiarity with SQL or other data querying tools strongly preferred

Core Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on data accuracy
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data integrity
Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, executive-level insights
Strong communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and automation

Preferred Attributes

Experience in Wealth Management, RIAs, asset management, or broker-dealer environments
Knowledge of data flows across custodians, clearing firms, portfolio accounting platforms, and CRM systems
Experience supporting enterprise reporting transformation or system integrations
Exposure to data governance frameworks and controls in regulated environments

Data Analyst 2 is an individual-contributor role focused on advanced data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, data integration, and stakeholder support. The position combines technical ownership of analytics products with responsibility for reliable, actionable reporting.

Duties & Responsibilities

Owns and maintains data dictionaries, data flow diagrams, transformation logic, validation rules, and reporting definitions for assigned products and services.
Leads defined data analysis, reporting, data integration, and ad hoc ETL activities across projects with limited supervision.
Gathers, maps, cleanses, and integrates data from primary and secondary sources while ensuring the integrity and upkeep of databases and reporting systems.
Analyzes complex quantitative and qualitative datasets to identify trends, patterns, risks, and actionable business insights.
Troubleshoots data-quality issues, coding errors, and reporting discrepancies and drives resolution with moderate independence.

Sponsored Services is Amazon's performance advertising solution for local and online service providers (plumbers, restaurants, salons, fitness instructors, and more), connecting them with high-intent Amazon customers through a conversational AI ad format that completes outcomes — quote requests, bookings, reservations, calls — directly within the ad.

We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to drive end-to-end technical delivery of this program, orchestrating dependencies across product, engineering, sales, marketing, legal, and finance to hit our launch milestones of open beta (2026) and general availability (2027).

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end program plan across closed beta, open beta, and GA, sequencing the Amazon Ads API launch, Ad Console integration, and vertical expansion.
Lead cross-functional execution of the program's critical pillars — measurement, demand generation, partner diversification, consumer trust and liability, auction/pricing model, formats — driving mitigation plans to closure.

Facilitate GTM gate reviews and executive readiness reviews, preparing exit-criteria tracking and communicating status, risks, and decisions to senior stakeholders; track dependencies with adjacent programs.

About Sponsored Products and Brands

The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace.
